FAQ

Plumber FAQ

Pricing, response times and warranty details for plumbing service across the Austin area.

How fast can you get to Austin?

Average arrival for emergencies is under 60 minutes, and most Austin calls are scheduled the same day. Call the 24/7 line and dispatch will give you an arrival window before you hang up.

Do you charge extra for nights or weekends?

No after-hours surcharge. You pay the flat diagnostic fee, we present a written price, and you approve the work before it starts—any hour of the day. Lone Star Plumbing Co. answers emergency calls across Austin around the clock.

How much does a plumber cost in Austin?

The flat diagnostic fee for Austin is $59, credited toward the repair. Common jobs are quoted as flat rates—a toilet install is $185+, drain clearing $149+, so there are no hourly surprises.

Do you guarantee your work?

Yes. Repairs carry a 1-year labor warranty and installed parts keep the manufacturer warranty. If a Austin repair fails inside the warranty, we return at no charge.

Can you handle slab leaks in Austin homes?

Yes. We locate slab and hidden leaks with acoustic and thermal equipment, then repair or reroute with minimal concrete cutting—common in homes across Austin.

Should I repair or replace my water heater?

If the tank is over 10 years old and leaking, replacement is usually the smarter call. We show you both numbers for Austin homes and never push the expensive option.

Do I need to be home for the appointment?

For estimates and repairs, yes—someone 18+ should be present. For scheduled maintenance in Austin, a gated entry note or lockbox code works fine.
